Study catalog

Source: vignettes/articles/studies.Rmd
studies.Rmd

Version française

Every study qesR can load: its design, population, size, licence and documents. qes_studies() and qes_docs() return the same information.

Code Year Family Study (DOI) Design Population n Licence Offline codebook

qes2018 2018 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2018 Post-election cross-section Quebec population aged 16 and over 3,072 CC0 1.0 yes

n is the number of respondents in the data file. Not every study is a Quebec Election Study: the studies of the families Durand election panel survey, CROP vote-intention polls and 1998 election polls are listed under their own titles, and their designs and populations differ, so check both before comparing studies. The licences, and the attribution the 2022 study requires, are on Citing qesR and the studies.

Study codes

qes_studies() lists 13 study codes. qes1998 is the panel file that combines the two 1998 polls, which also load on their own (qes1998_crop and qes1998_createc). The harmonized data of qes_harmonize() and qes_decon() cover 11 of the codes: every study but the two 1998 polls taken separately.

The 1998 polls surveyed francophones only, CREATEC by mother tongue and CROP by language of use. The files have no mother-tongue question that qesR harmonizes for 1998, so the examples count every 1998 respondent as francophone.

Weights

Each wave of a harmonized study has one recommended weight, or none. Only a weight checked against the study’s documentation and its file is used: 6 of the 11 studies have one. In the others, the weight columns of qes_harmonize() are NA, and the examples draw their estimates as hollow dots, marked “unweighted: no validated weight”. qes_spec("spec")$tables$weights gives every weight of every study, with its source.

Study Wave Recommended weight Status Calibrated on (as documented)

qes2022 pes pes_weight_general weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() age; gender; education; language
qes2018 post pond weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex x age; sex x region; sex x language; age x education
qes2014 post POND weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex; age; region; language
qes2012 post pond weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex; age; region; language
qes2018_panel pre weight weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex (sexfix); age (3 bands); region (fsa_tabl, 5 regions); mother tongue (s1, French vs other); education (scolU, university or not)
qes2018_panel post weight_rts weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex (sexfix); age (3 bands); region (fsa_tabl, 5 regions); mother tongue (s1, French vs other); education (scolU, university or not)
qes2012_panel pre pondam1 unweighted: weight not validated (weight columns NA) sex; age (6 bands); region (reg, 4); mother tongue (lmat, 3)
qes2012_panel post pond_post unweighted: weight not validated (weight columns NA) sex; age (6 bands); region (reg, 4); mother tongue (lmat, 3)

qes2007_panel post pond_tot_am1 unweighted: weight not validated (weight columns NA) poll (nompn); sex; age (6 bands); region (reg, 3); home language (lusage2, 2); education (scol, 4)
qes2007 post pond weighted: validated, in the weight columns of qes_harmonize() sex; age; region; mother tongue
qes2008 post none recommended unweighted: the file’s weights (pond, pondx) are calibrated on the reported vote sex; age; region (reg, 5); mother tongue; education; reported vote
qes1998 pre ponder3 unweighted: weight not validated (weight columns NA) pre-election intention stratum (vpl, through poids) x each firm’s weight ponderc (CROP: 1996 Census; CREATEC: undocumented)

By study

The Deposit line links to the deposit’s DOI. The document links download the file from Dataverse; qes_download() saves them in a folder you choose.

qes2022: Quebec Election Study 2022

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Pre- and post-election waves; Canadian citizens aged 18+ residing in Quebec (online panel)
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PAQBDR, Harvard Dataverse, version 1.1; licence Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0)
  • Data file: 2022 Quebec Election Study v1.dta (Stata data file), 1,521 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search()), under the study’s licence
  • Note: Two waves: campaign period (1,521 valid) and post-election recontact (1,220 kept), per the codebook’s methodological note. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2022")):
    • 2022 Quebec Election Study Codebook v1.pdf: Codebook, English, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2022")

qes2018: Quebec Election Study 2018

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Post-election cross-section; Quebec population aged 16 and over
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/NWTGWS, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Data file: Quebec Election Study 2018.dta (Stata data file), 3,072 rows
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Online post-election survey. Includes 251 respondents aged 16-17 (deposit note).
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2018")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR with programmed answer values.docx: Codebook, French, DOCX
    • Rapport méthodologique de l’Étude électorale québécoise 2018: Methodological report, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2018")

qes1998: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP-CREATEC Panel

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Francophone adult population of Quebec
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
